name: Growth Quality Score
description: Evaluates whether a company exhibits the structural traits of a durable long-term compounder — not whether it is cheap today. Built in phases: Phase 1 (Build the Evidence) constructs historical data tables and discusses trends across up to 6 capabilities, starting with Demand Strength, using up to 10 years of history (or since IPO if shorter). Analysis is based on EODHD data; where data is absent, yfinance is used as a fallback source.
